grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Volunteer ‘apprentices’ pair up with one of the last living speakers of a Native American tongue to learn a traditional skill such as basket weaving, with instruction exclusively in the endangered language.
sentences.zh: 志愿“学徒”与最后一位美国土著语言的活口者一起学习传统技能,

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: After about 300 hours of training they are generally sufficiently fluent to transmit the language to the next generation.
sentences.zh: 经过大约300小时的培训,他们一般都足够流利,能够向下一代传播语言。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: But Mufwene says that preventing a language dying out is not the same as giving it new life by using it every day.
sentences.zh: 防止语言消亡与让语言获得新生活不同,

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: ‘Preserving a language is more like preserving fruits in a jar’ he says.
sentences.zh: 保留语言更像是在罐子里保存水果。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: However, preservation can bring a language back from the dead.
sentences.zh: 然而,保存可以让一种语言从死里复活。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: There are examples of languages that have survived in written form and then been revived by later generations.
sentences.zh: 有一些语言以书面形式存在,然后由后世恢复。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: But a written form is essential for this, so the mere possibility of revival has led many speakers of endangered languages to develop systems of writing where none existed before.
sentences.zh: 但书面形式对此至关重要,因此,仅仅有可能重新出现就导致许多濒危语言的发言者在以前没有文字的地方发展书面系统。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。
